title: Manithan
desc: In order to earn quick money and fame, a struggling lawyer accepts a bribe and joins hands with a man who pretends to be a witness in a case. However, his conscience forces him to fight for justice.

title: Thittam Irandu
desc: While her marriage preparations are underway, Inspector Athira is busy investigating the death of her friend Deepa. Later, her life turns upside down when the whole mystery unfolds before her eyes.

title: Ragalai
desc: Karthik's mother decides to marry him to her brother's daughter Indu. However, when the uncle insults Karthik's family, he goes on a mission to destroy him.

title: M.S. Dhoni: The Untold Story
desc: M S Dhoni, a boy from Ranchi, aspires to play cricket for India. Though he initially tries to please his father by working for the Indian Railways, he ultimately decides to chase his dreams.

title: Nanban
desc: Two friends set out to find their friend from college, who taught them how to be more than just victims of circumstance. Along the way, they discover previously unknown truths.

title: Petromax
desc: Saravanan, an Indian living abroad, struggles to sell his ancestral home in India due to the supposed presence of ghosts in it. He devises a plan to prove that his house is not haunted.

title: Nela Ticket
desc: An orphan boy, Nela Ticket, is raised by Ananda Bhupathi at his orphanage in Bangalore. Years later, when Ananda is killed by a corrupt politician, Nela sets out to take revenge.

title: Jaya Janaki Nayaka
desc: Gagan, a brave young man, is unable to be with Sweety, his true love, due to her parents' disapproval of him. However, he vows to protect her after unknowingly saving her from gangsters.

title: Super Hit Songs
desc: A comprehensive compilation of the greatest super hit songs is played back to back in order to entertain and enthrall the audience.

title: Kanne Kalaimaane
desc: Kamalakannan, an organic farmer, marries Bharathi, a bank manager. However, his grandmother does not want his wife to work after marriage, which leads to a tussle between them.

title: Kalavani
desc: Arivazhagan, a mischievous young man, falls in love with Maheshwari, who belongs to the rival village. He abducts her and marries her after she confesses her feelings for him.

title: Saindhav
desc: A man with a traumatic past is compelled to encounter a crime boss so that he can rescue his daughter from a health problem.

title: Saakini Daakini
desc: Two police trainees set out on a dangerous mission in order to investigate the kidnapping of a girl from a nightclub when they fail to get the police's help.

title: Pisasu
desc: Upon witnessing the death of a young girl in an accident, Siddharth, a violinist, begins to feel a supernatural presence in his house. The mystery begins to unfold when he meets the girl's father.

title: Bhimaa
desc: After some mysterious instances at a temple of historical significance, a detective visits the region to investigate and find out the truth behind the incidents.

title: Sundeep Kishans Michael
desc: Michael, a gangster mentored by a Mumbai-based crime boss, aspires for greater things in life. However, an assassination mission and unexpected love complicate his goals.
